disclosure_workflow.what: Any proposed NIL contract or opportunity, before the agreement is entered. Outside deals are also reported in NIL Go as the handbook describes.
disclosure_workflow.recipient: FIU Athletics Compliance (Sr. Associate AD, Compliance reviews; Athletics Director also reviews deals over $10,000)
disclosure_workflow.form_name: Name, Image and Likeness Approval Request form
disclosure_workflow.quote: Prior to entering an agreement for the use of their name, image, or likeness, FIU student-athletes must disclose the proposed contract or opportunity through the INFLCR app.

important_claims: FIU requires disclosure through the INFLCR app before an NIL agreement is entered (2026-2027 handbook).
Deals over $10,000 need an extra review by the Athletics Director.
FIU logos, trademarks and any part of the uniform need approval from two FIU offices, a written agreement and license or sponsorship fees.
FIU bans endorsements of illegal drugs, tobacco including e-cigarettes, anabolic steroids, gambling, firearms and sexually oriented businesses.
NIL contracts may not run past the athlete's time in the FIU athletics program.
FIU facilities must be arranged and approved through FIU Athletics, with rental rates.
ambiguities: Policy 910.001 was last revised May 8, 2023, before the House settlement. The 2026-2027 handbook repeats its text, so it is treated as current.
Procedure 910.001a is 'temporarily rescinded' in the policy PDF, yet the 2026-2027 handbook still lists procedure steps (INFLCR app, approval request form, 10 days to resolve conflicts).

The handbook sentence on review timing is garbled: 'All transactions will be reviewed by the Sr. Associate Athletic Director shall be given within five (5) business days of receipt of the Name, Image and Likeness Approval Request form.'
The handbook's NIL Go text includes old dates (deals before June 7, 2025 reported by July 1, 2025). It restates the national process and is not recorded as an FIU rule.
The Panther Exchange (2023), The Blueprint Collective (2023) and ROAR (2021) come from pre-July 2025 releases. Current status is not confirmed. fiusports.com/exchange still redirects to INFLCR.

The Panther Club page says FIU and other Division I schools 'are able to offer increased benefits to student-athletes through revenue sharing' as of July 1, 2025. It does not say whether or how much FIU pays. No school-payments rule is recorded.
Kevin D. Kendrick's title reads slightly differently in a search result ('Senior Associate AD, Compliance & Deputy Title IX Coordinator').
Sports list is from site navigation links. Cross country was not in the links seen and should be checked.
No FIU guidance for international athletes on NIL was found in the handbook or policy.
conflicts: Policy 910.001 says to disclose 'through the reporting system established by FIU' without naming it. The handbook names the INFLCR app and also describes NIL Go.
